# commander_enterprise_role (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an enterprise role by name or ID. Returns the role's ID, name, users, and teams so you can reference them in other resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an enterprise role by name or ID. Returns id, name, users, teams.
# Optional: managed_company (MSP only) to scope the lookup.

data "commander_enterprise_role" "example" {
  role = "Developer"

  # Optional, MSP only
  # managed_company = "Acme Corp"
}

output "role_id" {
  value = data.commander_enterprise_role.example.id
}

output "role_name" {
  value = data.commander_enterprise_role.example.name
}

output "role_users" {
  value = data.commander_enterprise_role.example.users
}

output "role_teams" {
  value = data.commander_enterprise_role.example.teams
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) Enterprise role name or ID to find the role.

### Optional

- `managed_company` (String) Only applies to **MSP accounts**. Name or ID of the managed company to scope this resource or data source to. Omit to use the logged-in account context.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the found enterprise role.
- `name` (String) Name of the found enterprise role.
- `teams` (Set of String) Teams of the found enterprise role.
- `users` (Set of String) Users of the found enterprise role.
